result.rationale: The save() action in embeddable-host.js.es6 captures props (including category_id from this.get('categoryId')) before the request, but after the promise resolves it sets host.category from the CURRENT this.get('categoryId'), not the saved value. Two verifiable consequences from the diff: (1) if the user edits the category chooser while the save is in flight, the persisted value (sent in props) and the displayed value diverge; (2) for a new host, categoryId starts as null, the server substitutes uncategorized_category_id, but the client then overwrites the category with Discourse.Category.findB

judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:38 — P2 confidence 100: `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));` uses the currently editable chooser value after the request resolves, so changing the category from A to B while saving persists A but displays B as saved, and saving a new host with the default null chooser value replaces the server-selected uncategorized category with an empty displayed category.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition bug. Looking at the save() action in embeddable-host.js.es6 lines 29-38: the code captures `this.get('categoryId')` for the save request, but in the .then() callback it uses `this.get('categoryId')` again to set the category on the host object. If the user changes the category chooser while the save is in flight, the displayed category will be the new value, not what was actually saved. Additionally, for new hosts where categoryId is null, the server sets it to uncategorized_category_id (line 24 in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb), but the client will set category to null (since categoryId is null), causing a display mismatch.
